description: This file defines the 'Key' type and associated methods for creating key-value pairs in the OpenTelemetry attribute package, including methods for different data types and utility functions.

classes.name: Key
classes.description: Represents the key part in key-value pairs used in OpenTelemetry attributes.

methods.name: Bool
methods.description: Creates a KeyValue with a BOOL value.

methods.name: BoolSlice
methods.description: Creates a KeyValue with a BOOLSLICE value.

methods.name: IntSlice
methods.description: Creates a KeyValue with an INT64SLICE value.

methods.name: Int64
methods.description: Creates a KeyValue with an INT64 value.

methods.name: Int64Slice
methods.description: Creates a KeyValue with an INT64SLICE value.

methods.name: Float64
methods.description: Creates a KeyValue with a FLOAT64 value.

methods.name: Float64Slice
methods.description: Creates a KeyValue with a FLOAT64SLICE value.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Creates a KeyValue with a STRING value.

methods.name: StringSlice
methods.description: Creates a KeyValue with a STRINGSLICE value.

methods.name: Defined
methods.description: Checks if the key is not empty.
